post.youtube_description:
Hesiod made her the only mortal Gorgon. Ovid made her a young woman cursed by Athena after Poseidon attacked her. Then Perseus, a mirrored shield, and Pegasus.

#greekmythology #medusa #shorts

lines.text: In the oldest stories, she was one of three Gorgon sisters, and the only one who could die.
But the Roman poet Ovid tells it differently. In his version, she was a beautiful young woman, famous for her hair.
The sea god Poseidon attacked her inside Athena's temple. And Athena punished Medusa, turning her hair into snakes.
From then on, one look from her turned people to stone.
The hero Perseus beheaded her by watching her reflection in a polished shield.
And from her neck sprang Pegasus, the winged horse.
